original_download_inputs.role: Unedited web-authored scientific overview, including all seven sections and fourteen literature entries.

manuscript.scope: The overview supplies synthesis and literature connections. Existing theorems retain their proof sources. The joint-cost and replication formulas are explicit consequences, not a solution of either remaining extremal problem.

section_map.content: Bounded self-dual fields, smooth curvature models, derivative budgets and weak Bianchi testing. The fixed model is not the zero-Weyl endpoint; a new supplier must provide the actual form and source budget.
N1, negative-square and relative-shortfall costs, scalar-free coercivity and actual single-solution quantifiers.
Matched linear scale, arbitrary fixed finite-density endpoint, periods, whole cores, conditional realization and slow-mode geometry. The equality of low-defect infima retains its small-h range.

Spectral defect versus actual-field constraints; exact integrability versus weak estimates; Weyl interaction versus the simultaneous scalar cost; ideal configurations versus actual topological markings.
Density-independent endpoint and balanced optimum remain open. New suppliers and compatible geometries remain legitimate extensions, not mandatory prerequisites for the existing results.
All original entries retained below and in the preserved source, with version-specific links where the version matters.
The incoming overview used the September 29 manuscript and web increment. Its labels now connect to the October 3 assembly, which preserves the October 1 full integration.

mathematical_clarifications.formula: If m_j/k_j -> theta and k_j/Q_j -> 2/9, the conditional upper coefficient is 4-(8/9)theta*delta. The displayed 4-8delta/9 requires theta=1 or an all-site average saving.

mathematical_clarifications.topic: Norm and topology in the joint energy comparison
mathematical_clarifications.formula: W_tensor=4 W_operator; at fixed topology, Delta P=2 Delta W_operator+Delta S/12. Comparing a connected sum to its two separate summands adds 32 pi^2.

mathematical_clarifications.topic: Actual applicability of the 2025 gluing theorem
mathematical_clarifications.content: The prescribed oriented CH connected sum with reversed CP2 satisfies the 2025 Weyl theorem. A joint scalar estimate and a sufficiently large reproducible gain are still needed to change the balanced optimum. The 2026 theorem excludes a half-self-dual CH factor.

mathematical_clarifications.topic: Line bundle notation and source scope
mathematical_clarifications.content: The auxiliary field belongs to the fifth tensor power of the determinant line, not to a Lebesgue L5 space. The original web source remains unchanged; the derived synopsis identifies the current local manuscript.
